Add {{tl|watch}} to the top of a page

Adding a pipe (<code>|</code>) after either command will change the default text to appear instead as the editor's "reasoning" for the watching.

This template will also add the respective page to the [[:Category:Watched|watched]] category. This template is only meant for content with ambiguous, unconfirmed or completely missing copyright licenses.<br>
There is no need to type a period at the end of the reasoning, as a period is already provided in the template.

For example, <code><nowiki>{{watch|Image origin unknown}}</nowiki></code> will appear as...
{{watch|Image origin unknown|cat=nocat}}
<includeonly>[[Category:Message box templates]]</includeonly>
